QuestInfo.name: The Elven Court
QuestInfo.0: The #bthree Elven Elders#k have awakened: the wise #p1033100#, the energetic #p1033101#, and the serene #p1033102#... With their power combined, you just might be able to break the curse!
QuestInfo.1: #p1033100#, #p1033101#, and #p1033102# tried casting the #bRite of Snow#k to break the curse, but nothing happened. Maybe #p1033100# knows why it didn't work.
QuestInfo.2: #p1033100# said they might still be too weak to lift the curse, but worried that there may be something else going on and went to investigate. #p1033101# and #p1033102# decided to stay behind and tend to the sleeping Elves.

1.0: ...This is... Oh...\r\n#L0##bWhat is it? Did you fail?#l\n#k
1.1: ...Yes. This is...odd...\r\n#L0##bWe just have to build our strength back. If we were at our full power, wouldn't it have worked?#l\n#k
1.2: I'm afraid not, Your Highness. The Rite of Snow doesn't rely on its casters' power, and we performed the ritual perfectly...

yes.0: I felt the hearts and souls of the Elves. It SHOULD have worked. Our own magic was not the problem.

quest.0: What happened? The curse wasn't lifted... Did we fail?Ask #p1033100#.
